layers.description: The USGS Transportation downloadable data from The National Map (TNM) is based on TIGER/Line data provided through U.S. Census Bureau and supplemented with HERE road data to create tile cache base maps. Some of the TIGER/Line data includes limited corrections done by USGS. Transportation data consists of roads, railroads, trails, airports, and other features associated with the transport of people or commerce. The data include the name or route designator, classification, and location. Transportation data support general mapping and geographic information system technology analysis for applications such as traffic safety, congestion mitigation, disaster planning, and emergency response. The National Map transportation data is commonly combined with other data themes, such as boundaries, elevation, hydrography, and structures, to produce general reference base maps. The National Map viewer allows free downloads of public domain transportation data in either Esri File Geodatabase or Shapefile formats. For additional information on the transportation data model, go to https://www.usgs.gov/core-science-systems/national-geospatial-program/national-map.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The name of the road segment, as attributed by the source dataset.

columns.name: interstate
columns.description: A numeric or alphanumeric identifier designating the road segments that form a particular path through the transportation system. It includes the Interstate number and Business, Bypass, Alternate, or Scenic designation.

columns.name: county_route
columns.description: A numeric identifier designating the road segments that form a particular path through the transportation system, as attributed by a state or county-level transportation organization.

columns.name: mtfcc_code
columns.description: The MAF TIGER Feature Class Code (MTFCC) is a standardized code used by the U.S. Census Bureau to classify geographic features in the TIGER/Line dataset.

columns.name: state_route
columns.description: A numeric identifier designating the road segments that form a particular path through the transportation system, as attributed by a state-level transportation organization.

columns.name: tnmfrc
columns.description: The National Map Functional Road Class (TNMFRC) is a classification system used by the USGS to categorize roads based on their functional importance and characteristics.

columns.name: us_route
columns.description: A numeric or alphanumeric identifier designating the road segments, as attributed by the US Department of Transportation. It includes the US highway number and Business, Bypass, Alternate, or Scenic designation.
